title: Foundations
blurb: Your first beats — backbeats, steady subdivisions, and simple fills.

title: Technique Workouts
blurb: Drills, not songs: timing consistency, dynamics, and rolls.

title: Hip-Hop Lab
blurb: Boom bap through trap, drill, and neo-soul: swing, ghost notes, and 808s.

title: Four to the Floor
blurb: House, garage, and techno — offbeat hats and relentless kicks.

title: Breaks & Bass
blurb: Funk breaks, halftime, and fast chopped-break playing.

title: Global Grooves
blurb: Dembow, afrobeat, and Latin percussion patterns.

title: SP-404 MKII Workshop
blurb: Hardware walkthroughs, not charts: resampling, chopping, the sequencer, Bus FX, importing samples, and playing a live set. Button names follow the MKII front panel — check your manual if a shortcut differs on your firmware.

title: MPK Mini MK4 Workshop
blurb: Getting the most out of the controller itself: pad banks, note repeat and the arpeggiator, and saved programs. Button names follow the MK4 front panel — check your manual if yours is labelled differently.
